title: Canonical reduction and fixed-coefficient realization of derived pullback
statement: For a prime and finite coefficient extension [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], schemes and a morphism f:X→Y [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], use the actual finite and integral pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and the coherent reduction/limit calculus [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison]. Define the canonical finite reduction arrow from the reduction of integral pullback to finite pullback of reduction: first apply the specified integral-pullback model comparison, the inverse reduction evaluation, the reduction/limit counit on the actual pulled-back coherent system, its finite evaluation, and finite pullback of the source reduction evaluation. Also define the fixed-coefficient presentation of finite pullback by the two canonical exact-localization composition isomorphisms. These are actual composites; no existence, purity or invertibility is asserted.

def purAdicPullbackReduction
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E Y)) (n : ℕ) :
    (scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj ((integralDerivedPullback l E f).obj K) ⟶
      (finiteDerivedPullback l E n f).obj
        ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E Y n).obj K)
